what: The anytime-touchdown shadow (props/research/propmodel/td_shadow.py; PREREGISTRATION.md section 8). Research only: no page reads this file and nothing on the site uses it. Written only by the props job; never by hand.

bar.family: anytime touchdown: PREREGISTRATION.md section 8, "The touchdown shadow"

registered_with.oneshot_verdict: anytime_td PASS (C1 beta +0.378, 90% [+0.035, +0.750]); main_lines FAIL, so no main-line shadow

bar.population: every player on his game's anytime-touchdown list in the props job's published ESPN read (payload espn.games[gid].pl.td: the athletes the page's reader placed on a player; one it could not place is counted, never called), for each 2026 regular-season game still to come
bar.p: predict.py's P(1 or more rushing + receiving TDs) = 1 - exp(-lambda) from the frozen files of section 3, made in predict mode for the call's week exactly as oneshot_2026.py made it (week_rows, then Predictor.predict_rows), on this run's 2026 nflverse files, clipped to [0.001, 0.999]; none where predict.py makes no candidate row for him in that game, his group is not covered, or either club's previous 2026 game lacks stats, snap counts, play-by-play or weekly roster (oneshot_2026.coverage)
bar.m: the chance the published page states on his 'Scores one' row (data-legchance: legChance of the leg renderGame builds, DraftKings' fair chance, real or estimated), the page booted on this run's published payload at the run's clock with nothing kept in the browser; none where the page draws a dash or does not draw him. m is whatever the site states at the time: a change to the page's touchdown estimate moves it, recorded by build
bar.call: p and m from the same run; a call is made or rewritten only while its game kicks off more than 10 minutes after the run; rewritten whenever its numbers change; dropped before kickoff when a newer read no longer lists him, his game's read is withdrawn (none), or his game leaves the schedule or its week; frozen by the first run at or after the earlier of its own kickoff and the schedule's, or a score: the frozen call is the last run's before kickoff that made one
bar.outcome: PREREGISTRATION.md section 4(d), oneshot_2026.outcomes(): he played if the 2026 build has a row for him in that game (a snap in his role or on special teams); y = rushing + receiving touchdowns >= 1, a quarterback's own included, a pass thrown never; a return or fumble-recovery touchdown is recorded and not counted (the model's target and the site's settlement); no row: void
bar.void_also: the game kicks off more than 24 hours from the call's kickoff, or leaves the schedule; its own files (both clubs' stats, snap counts and weekly roster, its play-by-play) still not complete at kickoff + 14 days
bar.settle: graded once, by the first run at or after kickoff + 96 hours whose files cover the game; never changed after
bar.sample: the first 2,000 frozen calls graded td or no_td that have p and m and m not priced on the model alone: branch real, lined or backup, in grading order: graded_at, kickoff, game id, player id
bar.bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of whole games (nflverse game id), numpy default_rng(0), oneshot_2026.boot_weights; 90%: the 5th to 95th percentile; T1 and T2 each on its own stream
pass_if: T1: oneshot_2026.mean_diff(ll(b, y) - ll(m, y), games), b = m + 0.25 (p - m): interval wholly below 0
T2: oneshot_2026.signal_test(y, m, p, games, one stratum): logit P(TD) = alpha + gamma logit m + beta (logit p - logit m), beta's interval wholly above 0
bar.otherwise: FAIL: no new calls, unfrozen calls dropped (frozen calls are still graded); the model is not used
bar.if_pass: a candidate for a change of its own (a PR with the props audit's and the smokes' checks, the blend at 0.25 on the anytime touchdown); nothing on the site moves by itself; calls go on to the regular season's end as description, the verdict fixed
bar.before: no verdict before 2,000: running counts and point estimates only, never an interval, a verdict or a word of passing
bar.season_end: 2026's regular season only; with fewer than 2,000 in the sample once its last frozen call is graded, no verdict: undecided, which is not a PASS, and the model is not used
bar.changes: after the first call the shadow's code changes only to fix a mechanical failure, never a rule, a sample, a metric or a threshold, each fix logged with its reason in README.md; this bar never changes

summary.standing: 304 of 2,000 graded calls toward the verdict; the bar is judged at 2,000, not before
